islands.law:
# The atlas's value wave, as a law of nature. Transcribed from Atlas._wave:
#
#     V = max(source, best neighbour * (1 - decay)^distance) * passable
#
# with decay 0.06 (0.94 per orthogonal step, 0.94^sqrt2 = 0.916214 per diagonal)
# and a solid cell letting `leak` of the wave through — the harness's per-cell
# leak, innate then taught per hue by what pressing on it did.
# max8 also contains the four orthogonal neighbours, but they are discounted
# more there than under max4, so the max of the two is exactly the eight-way
# wave with a diagonal that costs sqrt 2. The harness paints source and solid
# each thought, steps this `subticks` times, and reads value at the centre.

channel source
channel solid
channel value

rule wave:
  when 1
  set value = max(source, max(0.94 * max4(value), 0.916214 * max8(value))) * (1 - solid * (1 - leak))

islands.law:
# Confinement suppression (night lab 2026-09-23, champion #35): a source hemmed in by
# solid counts less, so local food in a nook stops dominating and the frontier wins there.
# 24.5 meals on 32 never-seen FINAL worlds vs 18.8 the reference wave, 17.1 the tuned ghost.

channel source
channel solid
channel free
channel thing
channel here
channel value
channel confinement
channel injection

# Measure local solidity to detect dead-ends/corridors.
# High sum8(solid) means tight space.
rule calc_conf:
  when 1
  set confinement = sum8(solid)

# Inject signals, but suppress heavily if in a tight space.
# The division by (1 + k*conf) reduces value in dead-ends.
# This prevents the agent from being pulled into local maxima in confined areas.
rule inject:
  when 1
  set injection = max(thing, source) / (1 + 0.5 * confinement)

# Propagate the value wave.
# Use standard Bellman decay. The suppressed injection ensures dead-ends don't dominate.
rule wave:
  when 1
  set value = max(injection, max(0.94 * max4(value), 0.916214 * max8(value))) * (1 - solid * (1 - leak))

islands.law:
# Sources linger: a commitment law. The smell of a thing behind a wall is
# painted where the world's geodesic bearing points, and that bearing flips
# between the two ways round as the agent takes a step each way (seen on world
# 7: eleven frames out of twelve on the same spot, the source hopping left and
# right of it). Here a painted source keeps ~94% of itself per thought after
# the paint moves on, so the wave still holds the place it was first told and
# the nearer of the two stays the target. Where the agent stands there is
# nothing: `here` and its ring erase the ghost (an eaten morsel leaves no
# ghost to circle).

channel source
channel solid
channel here
channel value
channel ghost: init 0

rule linger:
  when 1
  set ghost = max(source, 0.99 * ghost) * (1 - here) * (1 - max8(here))

rule wave:
  when 1
  set value = max(ghost, max(0.94 * max4(value), 0.916214 * max8(value))) * (1 - solid * (1 - leak))

islands.law:
channel source
channel solid
channel thing
channel bad
channel here
channel leak
channel value
channel trail
channel ghost
channel confinement
channel injection

# footprint memory: 1 where the agent stands, fading slowly, scrolls with the map
rule walk:
  when 1
  set trail = max(here, 0.995 * trail)

# sources linger, but are wiped wherever the agent has recently walked
rule linger:
  when 1
  set ghost = max(source, 0.99 * ghost) * (1 - trail)

rule calc_conf:
  when 1
  set confinement = sum8(solid)

# seen morsels stay true; remembered/smelled sources lose weight on trodden ground and in nooks
rule inject:
  when 1
  set injection = max(thing * (1 - bad), max(source, ghost) * (1 - 0.7 * trail)) * (1 - bad) / (1 + 0.5 * confinement)

# Bellman wave; a burned cell does not pass the wave
rule wave:
  when 1
  set value = max(injection, max(0.94 * max4(value), 0.916214 * max8(value))) * (1 - solid * (1 - leak)) * (1 - 0.9 * bad)

islands.hypothesis: The map gets a FOOTPRINT memory: a slowly fading `trail` of where the agent has stood, scrolling with the map. Remembered sources (a `ghost` that lingers at 0.99) are wiped wherever the agent has walked, and smelled sources painted onto trodden ground lose most of their weight, while seen morsels keep full weight. Poisoned cells (`bad`) block the wave. This breaks the smell trap, where the bearing flips and leads the agent back and forth over the same cells. Ground the agent has already searched stops calling, so the wave goes to sources it has not checked yet and to the frontier, and the confinement damping keeps nooks from dominating.
islands.diagnosis: value on the test map: max 1.00, mean 0.53, 0% at the cap -> healthy: the best neighbour points at the source

islands.law:
channel source
channel solid
channel free
channel thing
channel scent
channel bad
channel leak
channel value
channel unknown
channel openness
channel frontier
channel confinement
channel injection

# what is not yet known (neither seen free nor seen solid)
rule known:
  when 1
  set unknown = (1 - free) * (1 - solid)

# how much unknown lies around a cell, spread a few rings out (bounded below 1)
rule spread:
  when 1
  set openness = 0.5 * avg8(unknown) + 0.45 * avg8(openness)

# the faint frontier marks: a source that is neither smell nor a seen morsel
rule mark:
  when 1
  set frontier = where((source > 0) and (source < 0.13) and (thing < 0.01) and (scent < 0.01), 1, 0)

rule calc_conf:
  when 1
  set confinement = sum8(solid)

# frontier counts by the unknown territory behind it; food as before; burned cells inject nothing
rule inject:
  when 1
  set injection = where(frontier > 0, source * (0.3 + 2 * openness), max(thing, source)) * (1 - bad) / (1 + 0.5 * confinement)

# Bellman wave; a burned cell does not pass the wave
rule wave:
  when 1
  set value = max(injection, max(0.94 * max4(value), 0.916214 * max8(value))) * (1 - solid * (1 - leak)) * (1 - 0.9 * bad)
